countPhiPrefix(std::int64_tx,std::int64_tfirst,std::int64_tlast,std::size_tbudget,constPhiTables&tables){if(first==last){return0;}PhiWorkQueueworkQueue(first,last);conststd::size_tworkers=std::min<std::size_t>(budget,static_cast<std::size_t>(workQueue.size()));if(workers==1){returncountP2Range(x,first,last,tables);}std::vector<std::int64_t>sums(workers,0);ThreadBatchbatch(workers);for(std::size_tslot=0;slot<workers;++slot){batch.launch([&,slot]{std::int64_tsubtotal=0;for(;;){std::int64_tbegin;std::int64_tend;if(!workQueue.claim(begin,end)){break;}subtotal+=countP2Range(x,begin,end,tables);}sums[slot]=subtotal;});}batch.finish();returnstd::accumulate(sums.begin(),sums.end(),std::int64_t(0));}
